questions.question: In your Data Entry Operator role at Iron Mountain, how did you verify that information in the computer system was current and accurate, particularly when processing confidential medical information?
Describe a system or account issue you identified and resolved at Iron Mountain. What steps did you take to investigate the problem and confirm the resolution?
You developed a filing system to accelerate paperwork processing. How did you assess the existing process, design the improved approach, and measure its effectiveness?

This role requires gathering and documenting business requirements. How would you work with Grants Management users to understand a problem and translate their needs into clear business requirements or user stories?
What experience do you have using SQL to query, validate, or analyze data? Please describe the types of queries or data tasks you have performed.
How would you validate a report produced from an Oracle or SQL-based system before it is shared with business users?
Describe your experience testing a new process, system change, or technology. How did you document expected results, identify issues, and communicate findings?

This position coordinates user acceptance testing, technical-team demos, and release communications. How would you organize and communicate these activities to ensure business users are prepared for a system release?
You have trained staff on technology and protocols. How do you adapt your communication and training approach for users with different levels of technical knowledge?

Agile teams use iterative delivery, backlog refinement, and frequent stakeholder feedback. What is your understanding of working in an Agile environment, and how would you contribute as a Business Analyst?
